stem.text: A square board, of side length $x$, hangs freely from a nail P, as shown.
The board has uniform thickness and is made from material of uniform density.

stem.text: A second square board, of side length $2x$, is made of the same material and has the same thickness as the original board. This second board is then hung from a nail Q. Nails P and Q are at the same height.
What is the vertical distance between the positions of the centres of gravity of the two boards?
